rendered: The review gives examples of solid-state relithiation (sintering with Li2CO3). Spent LCO was renovated by thermal treatment with Li2CO3 at 900 (cid:3)C for 12 h[1] (the LCO conditions). The LFP cathode was also directly regenerated by sintering with Li2CO3 at 650 (cid:3)C for 1 h under Ar/H2 flow[2] (the LFP conditions). So the LCO treatment was 12[3] times longer than the LFP treatment, based on the holding times stated for each.
